<#-- title: About Us -->

About Us

Who we are

We love to develop and extend business applications using Apache OFBiz, for its extensive framework, data model and ERP/CRM application. We are one of the top Apache OFBiz committers and a PMC member helping to determine the future of OFBiz.

AntWebsystems Co., Ltd is an officially registered software development company in Thailand under European management, and growing fast. We currently support OFBiz installations in North America, Europe and Asia, and co-operate with partner companies worldwide to provide local support. We are always looking for new partners to help make the Apache OFBiz open source ERP system successful in their area.

Let us know how we can help

If you are looking for quality support around the open source ERP product Apache OFBiz at competitive rates, you have found what you are looking for. We are one of the largest contributors and committers to Apache OFBiz and are ready to help you now. Tell us what kind of support you need and we will let you know within 24 hours how we can help.

How do we work?

We work to an internal development process based on the Scrum agile methodology. Scrum lets you see the progress being made every day, in agreed periods of one to four weeks, at the end of which usable system functions are delivered.

Requirements do not have to be detailed up front, and you can change them between those periods without a large impact on the implementation. We built and use a Scrum component to support this process: as a customer or partner you can log in and follow the whole process day by day.

What we can do

Anything related to Apache OFBiz: requirements gathering, implementation, interfacing, customization, and managing your production system. The services page describes each of these in detail.

<#-- title: Services -->

Our Services

Our vision is to make the professional ERP system Apache OFBiz and GrowERP available to small and mid-size companies at a cost effective investment, using open source software only. We help you not just with the implementation, but with maintaining and customizing the system afterwards.

These services cover the full lifecycle of the product within your company: documenting your business processes, gathering requirements, implementation and customization, introduction and end-user training, and monitoring and support of the production system. We can also train your own IT department to maintain the system, using Scrum, peer review, continuous testing and release management.

insights

Business systems consulting

Once you have decided on Apache OFBiz, we advise documenting your business processes with BPMN. After that first step the workflow is improved to obtain cost savings as early as possible, before the ERP implementation even starts.

Next we design a new menu shell around the ERP system, using as much of the standard system as possible and showing only the functions you really want, to keep it simple and friendly to use. That shell sits outside the core system, so future upgrades remain possible. The screens and functional requirements are documented in our Scrum system, and an implementation plan follows, including any integration with existing systems.

Because software development with the OFBiz framework is our core business, we have a complete product lifecycle built on open source support systems only, and we can help introduce it to your own development department.

deployed_code

Apache OFBiz implementation

With the implementation plan in place and the requirements defined as Scrum stories, we provide project management and an implementation team. We convert your existing data, create a new user interface to your requirements and carry out any further customization.

As soon as a usable part of the system is ready we set up the production environment and help you train your end-users and IT staff. We also provide the infrastructure for staging, testing and version management, and are happy to work alongside your local IT department.

hub

Moqui ecosystem implementation

We have people highly skilled in the Moqui ecosystem and in interfacing it with other systems. Our development environment runs from project management and accounting through to a proper distributed version control system with branch level security and peer review, automated testing, and a demo system updated daily so you can follow the work of the customization team as it happens.

smartphone

Android and iOS apps on a Moqui backend

We build mobile applications on a Moqui backend to your needs, whether you are implementing a new system or extending an existing one, in the same transparent way of working.

support_agent

24/7 support and system management

We provide system support worldwide, as long as your system is reachable over the internet. We install production systems on Linux including database setup, from a single server up to a load balancer with multiple application and database servers, set up backup procedures and upgrade services, and keep your system available uninterrupted with round the clock monitoring.

A second level help desk is available to support the technical people and the end-users in your organization, by chat or by email. Standard support contracts are available on request and can be adapted to your situation.

If you want to get started quickly, we provide a knowledge transfer service for organizations new to Apache OFBiz, as an on-site training course or remotely by chat and email.

Want to know more about any of these services?

Contact us arrow_forward

<#-- title: Products -->

Supported Open Source Products

AntWebsystems is primarily a services company, helping you use the open source system Apache OFBiz as efficiently as possible. Alongside those services we maintain a number of products, which we either use ourselves or which grew out of customizations we built for customers and have improved ever since.

All of them are open source under the same licence as the Apache OFBiz core system. Every product has a README in its root explaining how to install it.

Apache OFBiz

The Apache Open For Business Project is an open source enterprise automation project under the Apache License 2.0: ERP, CRM, e-business and e-commerce, supply chain management, manufacturing resource planning, maintenance management and point of sale.

It is a foundation and starting point for reliable, secure and scalable enterprise solutions. Use it out of the box or customize it to the most demanding needs, and grow your operations as your business grows without the deployment and maintenance costs of traditional enterprise systems.

Being open source and driven by a community, it offers flexibility by design, access to the code, and a solution where you can work with many others to get things done.

GrowERP

When implementing OFBiz we used to scale down from the full version, which is a lot of work to repeat for every smaller customer. GrowERP lets you start small and add functions as the customer needs them.

We found smaller customers are better served in a multi-tenant environment, so we normally add a component on top of GrowERP for customer specific functions that also works multi-tenant.

More information is at www.growerp.com.

Scrum component

A component we use ourselves, administering the major data of a Scrum environment: products, projects and backlogs. It accepts time registration from its members and can generate invoices from it.

Import / Export component

Makes data conversion easier, whether from another ERP system or from an older OFBiz installation.

Sitemap component

Creates a sitemap of every page in the website, so all pages are registered with the search engines.

Twitter component

A Twitter interface, letting you post by calling a service.

<#-- title: Become a Partner -->

Become a Partner and get more customers

Selling an ERP system, even services around an open source product, is not easy. Going out and talking to people directly, by mail or phone or whatever channel you use, does not work on its own any more.

Buyers now scan the internet for information themselves long before they contact an ERP vendor, which changes how the product has to be promoted. The number of competitors in the ERP market makes it harder still.

So how do you solve that?

Start with a marketing plan: define the product or service you want to sell, define the ideal customer, and work out how to find and approach them. Set up campaigns with actions, enter the prospects, and have sales people execute the plan.

All of this can be done by hand in spreadsheets, but in our experience it only works with a software system behind it. So we built that function into GrowERP. It is available as a hosted version or can be downloaded from growerp.com.

The plan is built on connecting to prospects over LinkedIn and, once connected, sending regular personalized messages automatically to stay in contact until they are ready to make the jump to open source ERP.

We also believe that selling ERP alone is no longer enough: the system needs functions your competitors do not have. That is why these extended CRM functions are the first thing a new user touches, increasing their sales before they use any other part of the ERP.

Working together

We have developed such a marketing plan ourselves using this GrowERP function, and are looking for partners we can help to increase their sales and who want to work together on local OFBiz and GrowERP projects. The partnership fee is very low to begin with. It will rise as the plans, the support and the system mature, and it can be reduced again when we work together on joint projects in your area.

Interested?

Let us know, so we can work together on making Apache OFBiz and GrowERP a success worldwide.

<#-- title: Jobs -->

Available Job Positions

We are always interested in hiring people with a passion for open source software and a good attitude. If you feel you can contribute to the success of our company, either in one of the positions below or in a position we have not thought of yet, let us know so we can arrange a meeting.

What do we offer? A good environment in a building just outside Chiang Mai, built specially for us, creating business software for customers all over the world. The ERP work is not easy: expect about two years to understand the ground we cover, not only programming but also the business disciplines, from product and order management to warehousing and accounting.

You can start as a junior tester or programmer and grow into a technical specialist, project manager or business systems consultant. In marketing and sales we are also looking for someone who can find new customers and, as an account manager, keep the relationship with our current ones.

Most important is that we can offer you work you enjoy, because then you have fun and we have someone who performs well. We are open source people: we share what we know and work together to give the customer licence free software. A bachelor degree or equivalent working experience is usually required, and learning quickly is very much appreciated.

Application tester

Creating automated and manual tests that run every day to keep the software as error free as possible. Basic Java knowledge is required; knowledge of business practices and applications is an advantage.

Software developer

You need the basics of a structured programming language such as Java and an understanding of relational databases. Linux and business knowledge help but are not required. Technology changes quickly, so learning fast and solving the problems you meet matters more than what you already know.

System administrator

We often run the production servers of our customers, where availability around the clock is required. You would also maintain the development machines and the network in our own company, all running Ubuntu Linux. Knowledge of development and testing tools is an advantage.

Project leader

Above all this asks for responsibility and the ability to work with people and customers. We use the Scrum framework, and basic technical knowledge of software development and production environments is required.

Business systems consultant

An advanced position asking for general knowledge of software development, open source ERP systems and business. You will meet leaders in the industry as well as operational people on the shop floor, and should be able to discuss business at any level.

Marketing manager

Developing a repeatable sales plan that helps sales people show potential customers how an open source ERP system can help them run their business. General knowledge of business and ERP systems, and above all of marketing, is required.

Sales people

Contacting potential customers over the internet using the sales plans already developed, coming back with suggestions to improve them, and presenting our open source ERP system.
